title: Backpack
description: Active carry-state. Curated, freshness-aware, replace-in-place. Mirrors the live backpack.json shape: a flat object of string keys whose values are either configuration entries (prefixed with '_config:') or BackpackItems. Each item validates against backpack-item.schema.json. Backpack answers: what should be near right now?

propertyNames.description: Keys are either '_config:*' for configuration or kebab-case item ids.

_config:pinned_keys.description: List of item keys that should always remain surfaced regardless of freshness. Stored as a JSON-encoded string in the legacy file; parsed array preferred going forward.

_config:ttl.description: Per-key freshness metadata. Stored as a JSON-encoded string in the legacy file; parsed object preferred going forward.

TtlConfig.description: Map of item key to freshness window.
